changes.title: Audio meter
items: The debug overlay (~) shows what sound is actually leaving the game, and the playtest log (L) notes every time it goes silent while the music should be playing, with where you were
?micCheck=1 lets the game listen through the microphone for sound cutting out after it leaves the game (debug only)

changes.title: Dj witch
items: Behind her decks the witch DJs: nodding on the beat, cueing in her headphones, scratching, riding the faders

changes.title: Stone legend apart
items: A legend no longer lies on top of a runestone: areas squeezed out by their neighbours don't get a stone, a legend and creatures piled in one spot any more
Legend circles keep clear of every nearby runestone, and the giant relics keep off the circles
